method.actualWorker: Every designated cold-start case and rank-policy fixture runs once in a fresh current-source process using default AdviceWorker; includes its actual cancellation callback and default ranked prefix 3; submit-to-result includes deepcopy and thread dispatch, excludes imports and UI timer/rendering; worker envelope fields are preserved separately from advisor output
method.timing: perf_counter around advise only; imports and process startup excluded
method.processes: fresh interpreter for every cold sample, each warm version, and each diagnostic version
method.equivalence: independent diagnostic runs; ignore only elapsedMs; compare all numerical fields at full precision with stated tolerances; actions/order/explanations/all nonnumeric values exact
method.legacyTimeoutReferences: Disabled; baseline and current diagnostics both retain the 2-second budget

fixtureAvailability.note: Optional local inputs contain only public state; no original game logs are committed.

integration.note: After measurement, rebased onto the background-window fix. Only autoplay.js, background.js and monitor.py differ from the measured tree. All advisor and worker modules are byte-identical; combined bridge/background tests are recorded separately in the evaluation document. These timings exclude WebKit and background-game execution.
